mapper.select:
select , c.name as contractor_name from cbs.t_project p left join cbs.t_contractor c on c.contractor_id = p.contractor_id
p.open_status = true
and p.proj_name like concat('%', #{kw}, '%')
and p.contractor_id = #{contractorId}
order by p.create_time desc
select count(*) from cbs.t_project where contractor_id = #{contractorId} and open_status = true
mapper.insert: insert into cbs.t_project (project_id, contractor_id, proj_name, proj_content, begin_date, end_date, proj_status, dept_code, creator, open_status) values (#{p.project_id}, #{p.contractor_id}, #{p.proj_name}, #{p.proj_content}, #{p.begin_date}, #{p.end_date}, #{p.proj_status}, #{p.dept_code}, #{p.creator}, #{p.open_status})
